name: pm
description: DataCraft project-management layer around Matt Pocock's skills. /pm:pm-scaffold stands up a minimal starter (day-one files only — every other folder is created on first write per the stamped CLAUDE.md taxonomy); discovery riffs work into docs/intent/<slug>.md with a size call; whats-next / checkpoint / stepping-away run the day as per-person append-only session logs; verify-before-done gates completion claims on fresh evidence; the credential-guard hook deterministically blocks staging credential-shaped files (compound chains, directory operands, quoted -C paths — tests in hooks/). Utility skills: okf (knowledge-bundle format) and granola-transcript (verbatim meeting transcripts into gitignored _pm/transcripts/). WORKFLOW.md is the stage chain of record; MIGRATION-0.8.md covers upgrades. History lives in the repo README and git log.
